note: Vendored verbatim (byte-identical, verified SHA-256) from quest-city-roblox schemas/stage-orchestration-contract.schema.json at the cited commit, R3C.2A+B canonical mainline integration. Not forked or modified. Formalizes the GUIDED_PRACTICE_IS_ORCHESTRATION_LAYER decision (R3C.2A, 02_36 section 20-bis): GuidedPracticeEngine/MultiStageQuestEngine are ORCHESTRATION_LAYER_CANDIDATE, not ENGINE. The orchestration layer this schema describes never owns validator logic and never resolves an engine itself -- engine dispatch always delegates to the existing Engine Registry / Support Evaluator via EngineDispatchRef.resolutionMode (RUNTIME_ADAPTER_ID or SUPPORT_EVALUATOR). SequenceRuntimeState never duplicates attemptState/completionStatus (02_26 section 18.6); AttemptReference is a pure stageId+attemptId pointer. If a Web runtime need cannot be expressed by this schema without a semantic change, do not fork locally: raise BLOCKED_CONTRACT_GAP and return the requirement to quest-city-roblox.
resyncProcedure: Re-read schemas/stage-orchestration-contract.schema.json from quest-city-roblox main (or its successor), recompute sha256 with `sha256sum`, replace the file under packages/content-schema/schemas/vendor/r3c2/ together with this provenance.json, bump artifactVersion/checksum/syncedAt/sourceCommit, and re-run the content-schema vitest suite before committing.
